description:
As a robot platform hardware test automation engineer, you'll be responsible for automating design validation tests for Zoox robotaxi hardware and systems.  This includes working closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Firmware, and Systems engineers to develop reusable libraries, tools, hardware interfaces, and scripts for functional & characterization tests with hardware-in-the-loop.  We're looking for someone with a solid software background who values code quality & long-term maintainability, who can help to enforce best-practices.

In this role, you will: 
 

 Implement design characterization tests for robotaxi hardware and systems. Develop reusable libraries for interfacing with lab equipment and displaying live test data.

 Collaborate with test leads to design test stations and plans based on technical specifications.

 Develop reusable tools for semi-automated tests and station configuration.

 Collaborate with design engineers and project managers to plan and support test campaigns.

 Document software to make it easily accessible to others both within and outside of the team.




Qualifications 
 

 BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

 10+ years of programming in Python (or an equivalent level of skill).

 5+ years of electronics or hardware testing (or an equivalent level of skill).

 Experience with concurrent programming using threads and queues

 Experience using test automation frameworks, such as PyTest or Robot Framework

 Experience developing Bash scripts or embedded C/C++ in a Linux environment.
